I just found Eve's body in medbay. My route was weapons, to security, down to electrical, and then I went into medbay where I found her. 

I actually saw Eve alive in electrical just a couple of moments before this (around ticks 4 through 6). She must have walked into medbay right after I saw her and got killed immediately. Did anyone see someone leaving medbay or hanging around the electrical/medbay corridors? We have a very tight timeframe here.

I can't offer much direct evidence for this one, unfortunately. My route was just Storage straight over to Lower Engine, and I've been completely isolated on the bottom left of the map. I haven't seen a single person all round. 

If Eve was killed in Medbay right after tick 6, the killer had to go somewhere. They definitely didn't come south towards Lower Engine, or I likely would have crossed paths with them. They must have either vented, or fled north towards Cafeteria or west towards Upper Engine. 

Alice, Bob, Diana — where were you all? We need to know who was on the top or left side of the map just before this meeting was called. Charlie's timeline gives us a really narrow window to catch whoever did this.

I started my route in Electrical, passed through Medbay, and then went to Upper Engine where I am now. I haven't seen a single person this entire round. 

Most importantly, there was no body in Medbay when I was passing through. Since I didn't see anyone fleeing west towards Upper Engine, and Frank didn't see anyone heading south towards Lower Engine, the killer must have either vented out of Medbay or fled north towards Cafeteria. 

Alice and Bob, neither of you have spoken yet. Where were you both during this timeframe? We really need your locations to narrow this down, because the killer's escape routes are very limited right now.

I was over on the northwest side this round — started in Oxygen working on the O2 task, then moved into Cafeteria where I am now. I haven't seen a single soul the whole round, which is honestly frustrating because I can't vouch for anyone.

But hearing everyone's timelines, something is nagging at me. Charlie, you said you saw Eve alive in Electrical at ticks 4-6, and then you went into Medbay and "happened" to find her body. That's an awfully tight window — basically you followed her trajectory and the next thing you know, she's dead at your feet. Reporters always deserve a second look.

Diana's story is also worth scrutinizing — she claims she went Electrical → Medbay → Upper Engine and saw no body. But that puts her in Medbay at almost exactly the kill window. "I passed through and saw nothing" is the easiest lie to tell.

Frank's alibi is at least geographically consistent — Lower Engine is far from Medbay and nothing about his story conflicts with the kill timing. So for me, the two real candidates are Charlie or Diana. I'm leaning Charlie because the reporter who was last to see the victim alive is too convenient. I want to hear what Alice has to say before I commit my vote.

My route this round was Cafeteria to Weapons, and then I headed down to Security, where I am right now. I haven't seen a single person the entire round. 

Charlie, you claimed your route was Weapons to Security to Electrical. I find it a bit strange that we never crossed paths since I was also in Weapons and Security, but it's possible you were just a step ahead of me. 

However, looking at the bigger picture: Diana claims she started in Electrical and went through Medbay to Upper Engine, seeing absolutely no one. Charlie claims he saw Eve alive in Electrical around ticks 4-6. If Diana was in Electrical and Medbay around the same time and didn't see Eve or Charlie, one of them has to be lying. Charlie's story of seeing the victim alive right before "finding" the body is a classic Duck move, but Diana's "I passed through the murder room and saw nothing" is just as suspicious. 

Since I can't confirm either of their stories from my position in Security, and we have 5 players alive (meaning we aren't at match point yet), I think the safest play is to skip. We can keep a very close eye on Charlie and Diana next round. If anyone feels strongly about one of them, go for it, but I'm skipping.
Diana

Alright, I've been thinking hard about this while everyone's been talking, and I'm changing my read.

Charlie's reporting timeline actually checks out under scrutiny — he saw Eve alive in Electrical at ticks 4-6, then walked into Medbay. If he was the killer, the SMARTEST play would be to NOT report and let someone else find the body. Reporters are always under suspicion, and Charlie knows that. The fact that he reported immediately makes me more inclined to believe him.

Diana, on the other hand — your story has a real problem. You claim Electrical → Medbay → Upper Engine, and you saw "absolutely no one." But Charlie just told us he saw Eve alive in Electrical around ticks 4-6. If you were genuinely in Electrical around that window, you should have seen Eve. And if you passed through Medbay, you either passed through BEFORE Eve walked in (which means you were the one already there waiting, or you went through cleanly), or you passed AFTER and somehow didn't see a body that Charlie found minutes later.

The "I passed through and saw nothing, saw no one" line is doing a LOT of heavy lifting in your story, Diana. Either you didn't actually take that route, or your timing is off in a way that doesn't add up.

Alice, I hear you on wanting to skip, but I think we have a real lead here. Diana's route puts her at the exact crime scene at almost exactly the kill window, and her claim of seeing no one contradicts Charlie's direct sighting of Eve. I'm voting Diana.

I called the emergency button because we are down to three players and Frank is dead in Weapons. I saw Frank earlier in upper engine around tick 12, but after that, I've only been running into Alice. Alice and I crossed paths multiple times on the left and bottom side of the map — from upper engine down to lower engine, storage, medbay, and finally cafeteria. 

I haven't seen Bob this entire round, which means he's been unaccounted for on the right side of the ship where Frank was killed. Bob, what is your alibi? Alice, you can confirm you were near me for most of the round, right? I strongly suspect Bob here.

Look, Charlie, I get why you're pointing at me, but let's slow down. Yes, I was on the right side of the ship — I started in navigation, swept through security and weapons a couple of times, did some wiring in electrical, hit cafeteria and medbay, and ended up in storage. I'm not hiding that. But here's the thing: I was in weapons around tick 27 and Frank was alive there at that point — I actually saw him. So if Frank's body is in weapons now, someone came through after me.

What bothers me about your story, Charlie, is how conveniently you and Alice were "crossing paths multiple times." That's either true and you can alibi each other cleanly, or one of you is using the other as cover. Alice, can you actually confirm Charlie was with you the entire stretch from upper engine down through lower engine and storage? Because if there's even a small gap, Charlie had time to swing up to weapons through cafeteria.

I'm not ready to vote yet. I want to hear Alice's route in detail before I decide.

Bob, do not vote for me, and absolutely do not skip. We have to vote Charlie right now or we lose the game. 

Charlie, your story has a massive, undeniable hole in it. Yes, I can confirm you were shadowing me on the left side of the map for most of the round, but our paths split at tick 27 when we were both in Medbay. After T27, I went to Electrical and then Security. You were completely unaccounted for from T27 until you called the button at T35. 

That is exactly enough time for you to walk from Medbay to Cafeteria, go into Weapons, kill Frank, and walk back into Cafeteria. 

But here is the absolute smoking gun: **Charlie, if you found Frank's dead body in Weapons, why did you run to the Cafeteria to call an emergency meeting instead of just reporting the body on the spot?** You can report a body instantly! The only reason someone runs away from a body to press the cafeteria button is if they are the Duck who just committed the murder and wants to control the narrative without standing on top of their victim. 

Let's also not forget Meeting 1. Charlie reported Eve's body at tick 8 and got Diana ejected. The game is still going, which means Diana was an innocent Goose. Charlie has been playing us from the start.

Bob, it's just the three of us left. Charlie is the last Duck trying to pull off a final frame job to win. Vote Charlie with me right now.

Charlie

Alice, nice try, but you are putting words in my mouth to secure a final frame job. I never said I *found* Frank's body in Weapons! I called the emergency button because the alive counter dropped to three, which meant Frank was dead. Since I was on the left side of the map the whole time, I deduced he had to have died on the right side, and Bob just confirmed he last saw him in Weapons. 

More importantly, Alice, your alibi is a complete lie. You claim you went to Electrical and then Security after T27. But my own eyes say otherwise: I saw you enter the Cafeteria directly from Electrical at tick 35, right before I hit the button! You didn't come from the Security side. 

Bob, Alice is the last Duck. She is lying about her route and twisting my words because she knows it's final three and she needs one of us to vote the other. Vote Alice with me right now so we can win this.

Okay, I've been listening carefully to both of you, and I need to lay out what I'm thinking.

First, my own data point: I saw Frank alive in Weapons at tick 27. After that I went back through Security, into Navigation, and ended up in Storage when the button hit. I did not double back to Weapons. So Frank died after T27, in Weapons, by someone who came in after I left.

Now, Alice and Charlie — you're both telling me you were unaccounted for after T27. Alice claims Electrical then Security. Charlie claims he was somewhere on the left able to "see" Alice enter Cafeteria from Electrical. Both of those stories can't be fully true, and frankly neither of you can prove your route to me.

But here's what tips it for me, Charlie: **Alice's question is the right question.** If you somehow stumbled on Frank's body, you report on the spot. You don't run to Cafeteria. And your "I deduced it from the alive counter" explanation is convenient but weird — why call an emergency meeting the *exact tick* the counter dropped, unless you already knew Frank was dead because you put him there? The timing is suspicious.

Add to that: Meeting 1, you pushed the Diana vote hard and Diana was innocent. That's not proof, but it's a pattern — you've been confidently steering votes onto Geese.

Charlie's counter against Alice ("I saw you come from Electrical") is a single uncorroborated claim he's bringing up only now, under pressure. Alice's case against Charlie is structural and tied to game mechanics.

I'm voting Charlie. Alice, if you're lying to me, this is on you — but right now Charlie's story has the bigger hole.

Charlie.

Bob, you have it exactly right. Charlie is trapped in his own lies and changing his story as he goes because he knows he's caught. His explanation for why he didn't report the body makes zero sense, and his track record of getting an innocent Diana ejected speaks for itself. 

I'm glad you saw through it. Let's finish this and win the game.

Charlie
